top_signals.title: Nvidia Board Meets to Consider Replacing Jensen Huang
top_signals.summary:
Technology-stock-driven rally came to a sudden halt as traders confronted a leadership crisis at Nvidia Corp. that risks reverberating across the global artificial intelligence supply chain.

Nvidia dropped 7% in premarket trading, with the firm’s board discussing Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang’s future after reports of multiple extramarital affairs, including one with a woman suspected of spying for China. Nasdaq 100 contracts fell 0.9%, threatening to trim the index’s best weekly gain since May.

The Opening Trade has everything you need to know as markets open across Europe. With analysis you won't find anywhere else, we break down the biggest stories of the day and speak to top guests who have skin in the game. Hosted by Anna Edwards, Guy Johnson and Tom Mackenzie. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Oil Prices Sink as Iran and Ukraine Peace Optimism Builds
top_signals.summary: Crude oil prices extended their decline today, with both Brent crude and WTI shedding over $1 in Asian trade earlier in the day on growing hopes for peace in Ukraine and Iran. At the time of writing, Brent crude was trading at $91.32 per barrel, and West Texas Intermediate was changing hands for $85.32 per barrel. Peace hopes for Russia and Ukraine came on the heels of the latest meeting of negotiators, even though that meeting did not end in anything resembling a future peace deal.
